note: One approved trace is the source: done/fixtures/studio-office/traced-studio, a reception, a corridor with a meeting room and a store, a passage of WCs open to a large studio. Every range and every allowed connection is what the trace holds, widened to what such a plan plausibly holds, so each rule is exploratory until more plans are traced. Double-swing is kept as a means of its own, which the other packs fold into swing.

rules.name: kinds-known
rules.subject: every space
rules.rationale: Counts, areas and connections are judged by kind, so a space of no known kind is judged by nothing.

rules.name: edges-name-spaces
rules.subject: every edge that is not to the exterior
rules.rationale: An edge to nothing is a graph that was not read right.
exceptions: an edge marked exterior goes outside and is skipped

rules.name: kind-counts
rules.subject: each kind
rules.rationale: One reception, one studio, a corridor and a passage; the other counts widen the trace's 3 WCs, 1 meeting room and 1 store.
rules.provenance: traced-studio: 3 WCs, 1 meeting room, 1 store, 2 halls

rules.name: kind-areas
rules.subject: each space
rules.predicate: has an area in square metres
rules.rationale: Widens the trace's areas to what such rooms plausibly measure in plans of 180 to 540 m2.
rules.provenance: traced-studio: reception 51.7, corridor 25.3, passage 14.4, store 12.2, meeting 25.0, WCs 3.5 to 3.6, studio 182.9 m2

rules.name: connections-by-means
rules.subject: each door or open edge
rules.predicate: joins a pair of kinds by a means
rules.object: listed in the pack's connections, double-swing apart from swing
rules.rationale: Double-swing doors are reception to corridor and corridor to meeting room; baths and stores have plain swing doors; the studio is reached by a swing door from the corridor and open from the passage.

rules.name: entry-is-reception
rules.subject: the way in from outside
rules.rationale: The trace is entered through its reception, though the studio has an outside door too.

rules.name: service-reach
rules.subject: a meeting room, a store, a WC or a hall
rules.rationale: The studio is a room to work in, not a way through to the rooms that serve it.

rules.name: wc-joins-passage
rules.subject: a WC
rules.rationale: Each WC is a cubicle off the passage with one door.

rules.name: passage-open-to-studio
rules.subject: a hall that has WCs off it (the passage)
rules.object: by an open link, not a door
rules.rationale: The trace's passage runs open into the studio at its end, drawn with a room separation line.
rules.provenance: traced-studio: the room separation line between passage and studio

rules.name: corridor-serves
rules.subject: a meeting room or a store
rules.object: a hall that has no WC off it (the corridor), which also joins the studio
rules.rationale: The trace's corridor serves the meeting room and the store and ends at the studio; none of them is off the studio.

rules.name: reception-joins-corridor-and-passage
rules.subject: the reception
rules.rationale: Reception is the hinge of the plan: the corridor one way, the WCs' passage the other.

rules.name: studio-is-largest
rules.subject: the studio
rules.rationale: The studio is 183 m2 in the trace, three and a half times the reception.
